subject: general
question:
Select the set of numbers from the given options which is **NOT similar** to the given set.

(15, 112, 13)
solution:
**Given set:** (15, 112, 13) 

The logic followed here is:

(First number + Third number) × 4 = Second number.

(15, 112, 13) → (15 + 13) × 4 = 28 × 4 = 112 [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/2705/72.png] 

Checking options:

I. (12, 72, 6) → (12 + 6)
